versions.changelog:
- Initial release of aliaskit skill, providing a persistent digital identity for the agent.
- Offers real email, phone number, name, date of birth, and a virtual payment card.
- Supports TOTP codes for 2FA/MFA and can handle email/SMS verification workflows.
- Enables sending and receiving emails/SMS, online purchases with virtual cards, and real-time event listeners.
- All identity data securely loaded from a local identity.json file; includes management and setup instructions.
